name: Taesung Park
current_role: Co-founder, Reve (AI image-generation startup, Palo Alto)
profile: Taesung Park is a generative-imaging researcher (Stanford BS Math / MS CS; UC Berkeley PhD under Alexei Efros) who was a Research Scientist at Adobe Research, where he built the upscaling pipeline for Adobe Firefly, before co-founding Reve with Christian Cantrell and Michael Gharbi. Reve develops its own image models and editing tools.
interesting_fact: He is a co-author of landmark image-synthesis work including CycleGAN/pix2pix code and GauGAN (SPADE), the sketch-to-photo tool named one of Popular Science's 100 Greatest Innovations of 2019.
deep_cut_fact: GauGAN grew out of his summer 2018 NVIDIA internship with Ming-Yu Liu; his PhD was funded by a Samsung Scholarship and he received an Adobe Research Fellowship in 2020. His Swapping Autoencoder research became Photoshop's Landscape Mixer.
notes: Researcher-founder with low media profile; his personal site publishes the email above. Fellow Reve co-founder Michael Gharbi's site says Gharbi has since moved to OpenAI - check Reve's current status before outreach.

name: Armand Thiberge
current_role: Founder and CEO, Brevo (formerly Sendinblue), Paris
profile: Armand Thiberge founded Sendinblue in 2012, an email-marketing tool for SMEs that he grew into Brevo, a full customer-relationship platform (email, SMS, WhatsApp, CRM, CDP, loyalty) with 600,000+ customers and about 1,000 staff. Renamed Brevo in 2023, it raised a €500M round in 2025 at a valuation above $1B and plans to invest €100M to expand in the US.
interesting_fact: Brevo became a French unicorn in 2025 after a roughly €500M ($583M) raise, had about €179M ARR in 2024 (+32% year on year), and earned B Corp certification in May 2025 with a B Impact score of 130.5.
deep_cut_fact: Brevo was founded simultaneously in India and France: in 2012 Thiberge opened its first offices in Paris and Noida, and its product began as the 'Mailin' / 'Mail in Blue' newsletter app run under his company Dual Technologies Services.
notes: Fairly private French founder; Brevo has a press page (press@brevo.com) and links his LinkedIn on its About page. Kapil Sharma is listed as a co-founder on French Wikipedia. Mail in Blue/Dual Technologies detail is from French Wikipedia.
